bitchat.title: Bitchat
bitchat.description: Chat with nearby Bitchat users over Bluetooth, without an internet connection.
bitchat.privacy: Nearby public messages are readable by mesh participants. Private messages are encrypted in transit. Chat history is saved on this device.
bitchat.name: Your public name
bitchat.public_notice: Everyone in the nearby mesh can read public messages.
bitchat.private_notice: Private messages are encrypted. Compare the fingerprint with the person before sharing sensitive information.
bitchat.empty_hint: Keep Bluetooth on and another Bitchat device nearby.
bitchat.error: Unable to connect or send. Check Bluetooth, use an updated build, and try again.

mobile.geo_privacy: Location channels use the internet. Messages, names, and the selected area are public to relay operators and everyone listening. They are not encrypted private chats.
mobile.invalid_area: Enter a valid geohash area code (1–12 characters).
mobile.area_picker_hint: Tap Region, City, or District to fill the area code using your location, or enter a custom code below. Only the area code is shared, never exact coordinates.
mobile.relays: Internet relays (one wss:// address per line)
mobile.failed: Unable to connect or send. Check Bluetooth, internet access, location permission, and the area or relay addresses, then try again.
mobile.storage_note: Messages and drafts are saved encrypted on this device until you clear local history. Connections normally pause in the background; the Android background-connectivity option can retain a joined mesh. Restoring a backup without this device’s key cannot recover saved chats.
mobile.mesh_privacy: Nearby public messages are readable by mesh participants. Private messages are encrypted in transit. Chat history is saved on this device.
mobile.geo_empty_hint: Keep the channel open to receive live public messages. Ephemeral channels do not guarantee history.
mobile.clear_confirm: Delete saved messages and drafts on this device? Other people and relays may retain copies.
mobile.contact_hint: Share or scan a contact code. Verification completes through an encrypted Bluetooth challenge when the contact is connected.
mobile.code_expiry: This code expires in five minutes. Generate a new code if needed.
mobile.contact_saved: Contact saved. Connect over Bluetooth and scan a fresh code to verify.
mobile.camera_denied: Camera access was denied. You can paste a contact link instead.
mobile.internet_private_hint: Optional encrypted internet delivery for saved mesh favorites and private conversations in joined public areas. Relays can observe your IP address and the recipient public key. No push notifications.
mobile.wipe_identity: Erase identity and all local data
mobile.wipe_confirm: This permanently removes your identity keys, contacts, queued messages, drafts, and conversations. Contacts will need your new identity.
mobile.queue_retention_note: Clearing history keeps contacts and pending outgoing messages. Pending messages may still be sent. Use identity erasure to remove them too.
mobile.connection_result: {{name}} replied in {{ms}} ms; {{hops}} link(s). This checks reachability, not identity.
mobile.courier_hint: Private text can travel through nearby phones as encrypted mail. Carriers cannot read it. Mail expires after 24 hours; delivery is not guaranteed.
mobile.gateway_area: Public area to share with nearby phones (optional geohash)
mobile.gateway: Share internet messaging with the mesh
mobile.gateway_hint: While Bluetooth is joined, publish signed public area messages for nearby phones and bring relay messages back to the mesh. This uses your internet connection.
mobile.bridge_hint: While Bluetooth is joined, publish your public mesh messages to this area’s internet bridge and receive messages from other meshes. You can choose Nearby only for individual messages. Also enables encrypted courier mailboxes on relays.
mobile.network_privacy: Both options are off by default. Public bridge and area messages are readable by others. Relays can see your IP address and area code. Private messages stay encrypted. Connections normally pause in the background unless Android background connectivity is enabled with a joined mesh.
mobile.network_failed: Could not apply network settings. Check the area codes and secure relay addresses.
mobile.bridge_notice: Public chat crosses the internet bridge for your selected area. It is not encrypted.
mobile.automatic_area_hint: Area chats and bridges use the five closest relays from the bundled Bitchat directory. Turn this off in Settings to use your custom list. Private courier mailboxes use the custom/default list below.
mobile.geo_private_notice: Encrypted private conversation for this area. Public keys identify accounts, not people. Enable internet private messages in Settings to send and receive.
mobile.geo_private_disabled: To start a private conversation from a public message, enable internet private messages in Settings.
mobile.channel_rotation_hint: Your public identity changes daily. Old keys accept private delivery for 48 hours. Your nickname and message timing may still identify you.
mobile.channel_identity_expired: This contact has not confirmed your identity change. The old key has expired. Continuing with the current identity may appear as a new conversation in their app.
mobile.channel_identity_pending: Waiting for this contact to confirm your identity change. This conversation still uses its previous identity.
mobile.send_failed: Message could not be sent. Check this conversation's connection and try again.
mobile.mesh_join_failed: Could not start Bluetooth. Check that Bluetooth is enabled and Nearby devices permission is granted.
mobile.geo_join_failed: Could not join this area. Check the area code and internet relay settings.
mobile.storage_failed: Could not save local preferences. Check available device storage.
mobile.geo_public_notice: Public internet channel. Relay operators and anyone listening can read messages and nicknames.
mobile.geo_private_active_notice: Encrypted private conversation. Verify the public key with your contact before sharing sensitive information.
mobile.channel_rotation_short: Public identity rotates daily; your nickname may still identify you.
mobile.mesh_offline_hint: This contact is saved but is not currently visible on the mesh. Private messages may wait for a route. A silent disconnect can take about a minute to detect.
mobile.background_connectivity: Keep connectivity active while in background
mobile.background_hint: Android only. Keeps a joined Bluetooth mesh and its open internet connections active using an ongoing notification. Join Nearby first. Location-only sessions still pause. Uses more battery; Android may still stop the app. Leaving the mesh, closing the app, or tapping Stop ends background connectivity.
mobile.background_unavailable: Requires an updated Android build. iOS cannot keep the current messaging engine continuously active in the background; connections pause and resume when you return.
mobile.background_failed: Background connectivity could not start. Allow notifications and Bluetooth access, check the notification channel, and try again while Outlink is open.
mobile.background_notification_body: Nearby mesh is running. Tap to open Outlink.
mobile.contact_retention_hint: Ordinary discoveries expire after 24 hours. Save, favorite, verify, or block a contact to retain their identity. Recent conversations come from the loaded chat history; clearing contacts does not erase messages.
mobile.contact_reconnect_hint: This contact identity has expired. Reconnect on the mesh or add their contact code before sending. Your message history is kept.
mobile.no_contacts_hint: Join the mesh to discover people, save a contact, or search another tab.
mobile.name_hint: Shown in Nearby, public location messages, and contact codes. Changing your name keeps your identity and conversations. New profiles start with Outlink followed by four random digits.
mobile.name_saved: Name saved. Nearby peers receive it through discovery announcements.
